map.📚 深度解析：湿疹(EASI)面积强度评估器: 📚 Deep Dive: Eczema (EASI) Area and Severity Assessment
map.四区评估：逐区录入受累面积（0–6 级）与四项严重度（各 0–4），工具按头颈: Four-region assessment: enter each region's affected area (grade 0-6) and four severity items (each 0-4); the tool weights and sums EASI with head/neck 0.1, upper limbs 0.2, trunk 0.3, lower limbs 0.4.
map.疗效对比：治疗前后各做一次 EASI，差值与降幅直观反映炎症与搔抓改善程度，辅助: Efficacy comparison: do an EASI before and after treatment; the difference and drop directly reflect improvement in inflammation and scratching, aiding follow-up.
map.重点区识别：输出各区分值，定位最重区域（如小腿苔藓化），指导局部用药强度与保湿重: Key-region identification: output each region's score to locate the worst area (e.g., lichenified shins), guiding topical potency and moisturizing focus.
map.示例：上肢面积 3 级、严重度均 2，下肢面积 4 级、严重度均 3 → 工具按: Example: upper limbs area grade 3 with all severities 2, lower limbs area grade 4 with all severities 3 → the tool weights to EASI ~20+, moderate-severe, suggesting intensified topical therapy and moisturizing.
map.EASI 分数越高越重吗？: Does a higher EASI mean more severe?
